resources.string: AutoWish uses this to send the WhatsApp wishes you schedule. At the time you picked, it opens the chat with your message and taps Send. It only works inside WhatsApp, only for wishes you scheduled, and does not read, save or share anything else on your screen.\n\nNote: AutoWish sends a wish automatically only when your phone is unlocked. If your phone is locked at the send time, you will get a notification instead. Tap it to send the wish yourself, or unlock your phone and AutoWish will send it for you.
